flutter: Tap / double tap / long press / pan
notes: Recognizer behavior and slop thresholds are tested.
Directional callbacks claim only their matching first slop-exceeding axis; generic drag remains available.
Two contact scale is accepted through compatible arena members before updates are emitted.
Per-window/pointer streams collect hit ancestors pending; taps, directional drags, long press, pan, and scale resolve before callbacks, with loser cancellation.
Payloads remain local to an explicit typed context; drag feedback is overlay-ready through DragDropContext::feedback; cross-window transfer is deliberately unsupported.
The retained sliver owns indexed drag state and reorder callbacks; box-level aliases and drag-start listener wrappers remain intentionally unexposed until they can share that protocol.
Ignore reveals painted siblings behind it; absorb blocks descendants and siblings behind it; capture is retained/window-local with optional native backend mirroring, not cross-window.
Focus handles, exclusive scope ownership, logical shortcut dispatch, and runtime editing shortcuts are implemented.

flutter: Focus scopes / traversal / Tab ShiftTab directional
notes: A focus manager owns one scope, skips excluded nodes, and implements cyclic forward/reverse Tab traversal. Directional geometry traversal is intentionally not promised by this compact API.

notes: Winit conversion retains distinct logical and physical identities, modifiers, location, key state, and repeat metadata; IME remains separate.
Typed command values and callback registry replace Flutter's Intent/Action subclass hierarchy.

notes: Text controller-backed fields validate, reset, submit, autovalidate on explicit user interaction, and unregister on drop.
